say:1:1441116001:1.text: When you run into the Sinned Ones in the wilderness, it's hard not to feel sympathy for them...
say:1:1441116001:1.source_cn: 如果你在野外遇到孽化之人，虽然心理会难以承受……
say:1:1441116001:1.male: When you run into the Sinned Ones in the wilderness, it's hard not to feel sympathy for them...
say:1:1441116001:1.female: When you run into the Sinned Ones in the wilderness, it's hard not to feel sympathy for them...

say:2:1441116002:1.text: However, in all circumstances, you mustn't show them any mercy.
say:2:1441116002:1.source_cn: 但，不能对他们手下留情。

say:3:1441116003:0.text: The Sinned Ones are no longer their former selves. If the corruption spreads among the crowd, the consequences will be catastrophic.
say:3:1441116003:0.source_cn: 孽化之人已经不再是他们自己，孽化在人群中传播，将引发更...

say:4:1441116004:1.text: We mustn't let them squander the Queen's grace.
say:4:1441116004:1.source_cn: 女王的恩典珍贵无匹，不能任其挥霍。
